description:
Decision D3 (owner chose to decouple): t3:durations should not duplicate the release canary. Confirmed: in run 39125986956 the slow tier (672 selected, 4 failed) failed the domain through the final step 'Require successful sampled tests' (.github/workflows/nightly-v2.yml about lines 1012-1024), and the same four tests are the release canary failures on the same commit (3b3cfbcaa). The runbook documents the old rule (docs/internal/nightly-t3.md line ~30: failed sampled tests fail the domain, missing verdicts fail closed).
GATE-D (precondition, record the result): prove the canary selection ((slow or resource_heavy) and not (stress or live_integration)) is a superset of the durations slow tier (slow and not (stress or resource_heavy or live_integration)) with pytest --collect-only -q set difference; record counts; also record that the fast-tier tests run in PR/trunk lanes. If the slow-tier difference is non-empty, do not decouple those tests: either add them to the canary selection in a separately reviewed change or block the item.
New behavior: the domain fails only when a verdict file is missing, pytest exits >1 (usage, internal or no-tests), junit is missing or unparseable, or duration tooling fails. pytest exit 1 (test failures) emits a ::warning:: naming the failing test ids, retains artifacts and passes. Update the runbook row.
